assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: Install it free as a DWG/DXF viewer, PDF plotter and quick 2D drafting tool. Keep AutoCAD (or the original file) for client drawings: saving changes every release, and the README and v0.6.2 notes disagree on what a save keeps.

assignments.name: cost
assignments.value: Free. MIT or Apache-2.0, no account, no subscription (README).

assignments.name: install
assignments.value: github.com/storytold/cadcraft/releases/latest: Windows .msi or portable .zip, macOS .dmg, Linux AppImage/.deb/.rpm/Flatpak/tarball, FreeBSD tarball, web build zip.
